name: At War With The Scarlet Crusade
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
We are still at war and the Scarlet Crusade grows in strength.  The report Executor Arren sent me indicates Scarlet Crusaders have been raiding from the ruined tower in southeastern Tirisfal near the Balnir Farmstead under the command of Captain Vachon.

Kill Vachon along with 5 Scarlet Friars. It should prove to be a devastating blow to the Crusade!
narrative.objectives: Executor Zygand in Brill has commissioned you to slay Captain Vachon and 5 Scarlet Friars.
narrative.offerRewardText: Captain Vachon's death will slow down the Scarlet Crusade's advancement in Tirisfal quite a bit. But other threats loom.
narrative.requestItemsText: I see you have returned but your task is not complete. Perhaps you are at ease with the mere humans interfering with The Dark Lady's plan? Or perhaps you can heed the call of duty and slay Captain Vachon and his band of Scarlet Friars!
